_readme: Attendee-facing schedule for the Creator Carnival, from the run of show. Edit this file and redeploy — no code changes needed. Times are 24h wall-clock at the venue (America/New_York). Deliberately excludes crew-only content (load-in, DJ cue map, mic plan, staffing) and unconfirmed panellists — set lineup_tbc true and leave `people` out until a name is locked. The exhibitor list is NOT here: it is generated from real booth signups in ccc_booth_signups.

event.name: Creator Carnival
event.note: Booths, vendors and activations run all day. The stage schedule is below.

schedule.title: Jump DC — Double Dutch
schedule.subtitle: Wellness + movement activation
schedule.description: An interactive double-dutch experience to open the Carnival. Crowd participation — come and get in the rope.

schedule.title: Line Dancing with Tiara Felder
schedule.description: Led line dancing, open to everyone. Crowd participation and content moments.

schedule.title: Welcome to Creator Carnival
schedule.description: Khadijah opens and introduces Folasade and Tommy. What today is about, how to take part, and what creators, brands and attendees can expect from the day.

schedule.title: Bet On Yourself
schedule.subtitle: What happens when you stop waiting for permission
schedule.description: Before you build anything, you have to believe you’re capable of building it.

schedule.title: DJ Break
schedule.description: A musical reset — stretch your legs, walk the booths, meet someone.

schedule.title: Tommy + Cult Content
schedule.description: A short conversation about Creator Carnival, Cult Content and the wider creative ecosystem.

schedule.title: Build the Brand
schedule.subtitle: Turning creator community into culture + commerce
people: Rizz the Great — DMV Wholesale Dept.
schedule.description: “I believe in myself — now how do I build something?” Building brands and community, collaboration, and turning creativity into something sustainable.

schedule.title: 7G Bummin
schedule.subtitle: Creator Carnival experience
schedule.description: A deliberate break from the stage — crowd interaction, jumbotron moments, vendor engagement, photos and video. This is where the day should actually feel like a carnival.

schedule.title: BOMESI
schedule.description: The accelerator, access and resources — what creators can actually do next, and how to position yourself for opportunities.

schedule.title: Why Won’t You Put Me On?
schedule.subtitle: What building together really looks like
schedule.description: Creator and brand collaboration, the future of brand integration, shoppable content, and where media is going — the Unskrypted story told as a conversation rather than a pitch.

schedule.title: DJ Reset
schedule.description: A quick musical reset — good moment to move between the booths.

schedule.title: From Creator to Bigger Opportunities
schedule.description: You’ve built something, found your voice, created the audience. Now what? Breaking into film and TV, casting, representation, and what the industry actually looks for.

schedule.title: TOB — Live Performance
schedule.subtitle: The big close
schedule.description: The Carnival finale. Live performance, creator and vendor recognition, sponsor shoutouts, closing remarks, and one big final song.
